question: What Are the Different Types of Controllers in Instrumentation?
body_html:
Types of controllers in instrumentation are grouped by how they react to error: on off, P, PI, PD and PID. Each compares the measured value with the setpoint.

ControllerKey behaviourTypical use
On offOutput fully on or fully offThermostats, tank pumps
POutput proportional to error, leaves offsetFlow and speed control
PIIntegral removes steady state errorMost flow and pressure loops
PDDerivative reacts to rate of changeLoops needing less overshoot
PIDCombines all three actionsTemperature and critical loops
